description.p: Hamr builds 3D models out of primitives, in the spirit of the Second Life build tools. Boxes, cylinders, spheres, tori, tubes, rings and prisms can be cut, hollowed, twisted and tapered, then linked, mirrored and arrayed into larger models.

Export merges everything into one watertight solid and writes STL, OBJ or glTF, ready for a slicer or a game engine. A printability check warns about overhangs, floating pieces and models too big for the printer.
